text: DEFONEOS — DEFRA Environmental Regulation AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DEFRA × ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATION DEFRA Environmental Regulation AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK environmental regulation — pollution control, environmental permitting, enforcement, and compliance monitoring across the Environment Agency, Natural England, NRW, and SEPA. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Permitting Environmental Permitting AI Permit application intake and processing. Risk-based assessment methodology. Activity-specific permit conditions generation. Water discharge consent management. Air emission permits under Environmental Permitting Regulations 2016. Waste management licensing. Mining waste facility permits. Bespoke variation and transfer processing. Pollution Pollution Control & Detection AI Water pollution incident detection via sensor networks. Air quality monitoring across UK-AIR network. Noise pollution enforcement under statutory nuisance provisions. Contaminated land assessment under Part 2A. Chemical release tracking and inventory. Agricultural runoff monitoring (nitrate/phosphate). Industrial emission compliance checking. Transboundary pollution coordination (OSPAR, EU retained law). Enforcement Environmental Enforcement AI Compliance inspection scheduling using risk-scoring. Breach detection and severity grading. Enforcement notice drafting and service. Prosecution case evidence compilation. Civil sanctions regime management (Civil Sanctions Order 2010). Variable monetary penalty calculation. Stop notice and compliance notice issuance. Remediation order tracking and completion. Monitoring Environmental Monitoring AI Real-time sensor network data fusion (water, air, soil). Satellite imagery analysis for land-use change. Water quality sampling programme management. Air quality index calculation and forecasting. Biodiversity monitoring through eDNA and camera traps. Soil contamination testing and trend analysis. Noise level mapping and complaint correlation. Climate impact assessment for regulated sites. Planning Environmental Planning Integration AI Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) screening and scoping. Habitats Regulations Assessment (HRA) for European sites. Strategic Environmental Assessment (SEA) for plans and programmes. Screening opinion generation for development proposals. Appropriate assessment for plan-making. Mitigation hierarchy verification. Biodiversity net gain metric calculation. Cumulative impact assessment across developments. Waste Waste Regulation AI Duty of care compliance monitoring under s.34 EPA 1990. Waste carrier, broker, dealer registration verification. Hazardous waste consignment tracking. Fly-tipping detection via satellite and drone imagery. Circular economy compliance metrics. Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) obligations. Packaging waste recovery and recycling notes. WEEE compliance and producer responsibility. Water Water Resources Regulation AI Water abstraction licensing and reform (Hands Off Flow). Drought management and drought permit/Order processing. Water company environmental performance assessment. Bathing water quality monitoring and classification. Groundwater protection zone compliance. Flood risk integration with environmental objectives. Hydromorphology assessment for river restoration. Water Framework Directive (WFD) classification and action planning. Chemicals Chemical Regulation AI UK REACH compliance monitoring. CLP classification and labelling review. Biocidal products authorisation processing. Pesticide active substance approval and renewal. Persistent organic pollutant (POPs) tracking.
